thought.text: All 5 backend services are healthy, and Corretto 25 is ready. Starting the Spring Boot app with Gradle.

reasoning_content:
Excellent!

1. Corretto 25 is installed at /opt/java25.
2. All 5 docker-compose services are up and running! meilisearch, postgres (healthy), keycloak (healthy), localstack (healthy), poi-test-api (healthy).

Next, run the Gradle build with JDK 25. Set JAVA_HOME=/opt/java25. Run bootRun in the background with logging, then verify the API endpoint.

action.command:
cd /workspace/backend && (JAVA_HOME=/opt/java25 ./gradlew :menden-app:bootRun --no-daemon --console=plain > /tmp/bootrun.log 2>&1; echo "BOOTRUN_EXIT=$?" >> /tmp/bootrun.log) &
echo "bootRun started"; sleep 30; tail -5 /tmp/bootrun.log
